title: 12 Types of People Who Will Prosper on Earth
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reveals the 12 types of people who will experience extreme prosperity on earth, from those who delight in God's word to those who sow generously in every season. As he shares the biblical promises and principles that undergird this prosperity, Pastor Zehner also issues a call to action, challenging listeners to join him and The River Church of Kansas City in a 50-state revival tour aimed at saving 1.5 million souls in America. Whether you're seeking to deepen your faith or be part of a groundbreaking movement, this sermon is not to be missed.
